dog bite cases, the Animal Welfare Board of India (AWBI) reiterates the urgent need to distinguish
between pet dog and street (stray) dog bites. The format already includes fields for capturing dog
ownership and category, thereby facilitating such classification.

being logged as stray dog bites.
